title: herschelia newdigateae
intro: Herschelia newdigateae, commonly known as the Newdigate Herschelia, is a plant species belonging to the family Iridaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Herschelia newdigateae include reducing inflammation, acting as an expectorant to aid in cough relief, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects.
